problem:

r=⟨{e}^{{t}^{2}-1},2-5t⟩,\,t>0.
$$

Question 2
?

The position vector r of a particle P (relative to a fixed origin O) at time t is given by r=⟨et2−1,2−5t⟩,t>0. Calculate the velocity vector v.

a
v=⟨et2−1,2⟩
b
v=⟨2tet2−1,2⟩
c
v=⟨tet2−1,−5⟩
d
v=⟨et2−1,−5⟩
e
v=⟨2tet2−1,−5⟩
